comparison.objective: Insert a cotter pin through a clevis and plastically bend both legs to retain it; candidate tunes and locks a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: PR requires small-part insertion and irreversible opposed-leg bending. Candidate requires reversible hex-tool engagement, captive-screw loosening, collar adjustment, socket reacquisition, and relocking.
comparison.success_condition: PR requires seating, both legs bent ≥45°, release, stability, and no excessive rebending. Candidate requires two repeatable impact stops and no bottoming, overload, rebound, damage, or collar drift.
comparison.reason: Although both secure mechanisms, irreversible cotter deformation is not the candidate's adjustable locking-and-testing ability.
